info.title: DisputeDesk Tools API
info.description: Backend tools for the DisputeDesk card-dispute AI agent.

get.summary: Look up a dispute by ID.
get.description: Returns the dispute record and the card type (credit or debit) of the charged account. Use this as your first call when a customer reports a problem.

get.summary: Look up a transaction and check for duplicates.
get.description: Returns all details of a transaction including the merchant name, card type, any subscription dates, any refunds, and any other charges on the same card at the same merchant for the same amount within 24 hours.

get.summary: Get a customer's transaction history and optional fraud signals.
get.description: Returns the customer's account open date and up to 50 recent transactions. When you also supply merchant_id and transaction_id, the response includes friendly_fraud_signals: counts of prior purchases at the same merchant using the same device or shipping address, device/address novelty flags, and the customer's dispute history.

parameters.name: transaction_id

schema.description: The disputed transaction ID. Required with merchant_id to get fraud signals.
schema.title: Transaction Id

parameters.description: The disputed transaction ID. Required with merchant_id to get fraud signals.

get.summary: Look up a merchant and optional shipment details.
get.description: Returns the merchant's name, category, whether they operate online, and their refund policy. Provide transaction_id to also get the shipment record for that order.

parameters.name: transaction_id

schema.description: Include the shipment record for this transaction, if one exists.
schema.title: Transaction Id

parameters.description: Include the shipment record for this transaction, if one exists.

get.summary: Check whether a dispute was filed within the time limits.
get.description: Checks a dispute against the card network's 120-day limit (counted from the expected delivery date for reason code 13.1) and the 60-day customer notice limit in Regulation Z (credit cards) or Regulation E (debit cards). Returns within_time_limits, too_early (13.1 only), the exact deadline dates, and the deadlines the bank must meet. Always use this instead of calculating dates yourself.

parameters.name: reason_code

schema.description: The Visa reason code chosen for this dispute: 10.4, 12.6.1, 13.1, 13.2, 13.3, 13.6 or N/A.

parameters.description: The Visa reason code chosen for this dispute: 10.4, 12.6.1, 13.1, 13.2, 13.3, 13.6 or N/A.

get.summary: Get the rule-based recommendation and confidence score for a dispute.
get.description: Applies DisputeDesk's written decision rules to a dispute and returns the recommendation (file_chargeback, deny, request_more_info or escalate), the rule that produced it, the 4 confidence checks (within time limits, evidence found, history fits the claim, reason code clear) and the key evidence. Use this as the final step of every investigation and present its recommendation exactly; do not change it. A human analyst makes the final decision.

parameters.name: reason_code

schema.description: The Visa reason code chosen for this dispute: 10.4, 12.6.1, 13.1, 13.2, 13.3, 13.6 or N/A.

parameters.description: The Visa reason code chosen for this dispute: 10.4, 12.6.1, 13.1, 13.2, 13.3, 13.6 or N/A.

parameters.name: customer_contacted_merchant

schema.description: True if the complaint says the customer contacted the merchant or returned the item (matters for 13.3).
schema.title: Customer Contacted Merchant

parameters.description: True if the complaint says the customer contacted the merchant or returned the item (matters for 13.3).

acknowledge_by.title: Acknowledge By
acknowledge_by.description: Credit cards only: date by which the bank must acknowledge the dispute in writing (Reg Z, 30 days).

investigate_by.title: Investigate By
investigate_by.description: Debit cards only: date by which the bank must finish investigating (Reg E, 10 business days).

resolve_by.title: Resolve By
resolve_by.description: Latest date by which the bank must resolve the dispute (90 days after it was filed).

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain-English explanation of these bank deadlines.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One plain-English line explaining the result.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer whose history is shown.

account_open_date.title: Account Open Date
account_open_date.description: Date the customer opened their account.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Up to 50 of the customer's most recent transactions, newest first.

friendly_fraud_signals.description: Populated only when both merchant_id and transaction_id query parameters are provided. Contains evidence relevant to assessing whether the dispute may be a familiar purchase the customer later denied.

reason_code.title: Reason Code
reason_code.description: The reason code the deadlines were checked for.

regulation.title: Regulation
regulation.description: 'Reg Z' for credit cards or 'Reg E' for debit cards.

statement_date.title: Statement Date
statement_date.description: Statement on which the charge first appeared (YYYY-MM-DD).

filed_date.title: Filed Date
filed_date.description: Date the customer filed the dispute (YYYY-MM-DD).

network_start_date.title: Network Start Date
network_start_date.description: Date the 120-day card network limit counts from: the transaction date, or the expected delivery date for 13.1.

network_deadline.title: Network Deadline
network_deadline.description: Last day to file under the 120-day card network limit.

network_ok.title: Network Ok
network_ok.description: True if the dispute was filed within the card network limit.

regulation_notice_deadline.title: Regulation Notice Deadline
regulation_notice_deadline.description: Last day for the customer's notice under Reg Z or Reg E (60 days after the statement).

regulation_ok.title: Regulation Ok
regulation_ok.description: True if the customer's notice was within the 60-day regulation limit.

too_early.title: Too Early
too_early.description: True only for 13.1 when the dispute was filed before the expected delivery date.

within_time_limits.title: Within Time Limits
within_time_limits.description: True only if both the card network limit and the regulation limit were met. If false, the dispute was filed too late.

bank_response_deadlines.description: Deadlines the bank itself must meet when handling this dispute.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One plain-English sentence summarizing the deadline check.

dispute_id.title: Dispute Id
dispute_id.description: Unique identifier for this dispute (e.g. DSP-0001).

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: The transaction the customer is disputing.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer who filed the dispute.

filed_date.title: Filed Date
filed_date.description: Date the customer filed the dispute (YYYY-MM-DD).

complaint_text.title: Complaint Text
complaint_text.description: The customer's complaint in their own words.

card_type.title: Card Type
card_type.description: Whether the disputed charge was on a credit or debit card.

prior_undisputed_with_merchant.title: Prior Undisputed With Merchant
prior_undisputed_with_merchant.description: Number of earlier charges at the same merchant that were never disputed. A high count can indicate the customer knows the merchant well.

same_device_count.title: Same Device Count
same_device_count.description: Among those prior purchases at the same merchant, how many used the same device as the charge being investigated.

same_address_count.title: Same Address Count
same_address_count.description: Among those prior purchases at the same merchant, how many were shipped to the same address as the charge being investigated.

device_seen_before.title: Device Seen Before
device_seen_before.description: True if the device used for the disputed charge appeared in any earlier transaction by this customer, not just with this merchant.

address_seen_before.title: Address Seen Before
address_seen_before.description: True if the shipping address on the disputed charge appeared in any earlier transaction by this customer, not just with this merchant.

prior_disputes_count.title: Prior Disputes Count
prior_disputes_count.description: Total number of past disputes (any status) filed by this customer.

prior_disputes_lost.title: Prior Disputes Lost
prior_disputes_lost.description: Number of past disputes where the outcome was resolved_merchant (the merchant won). A high number alongside other signals may warrant closer review.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One plain-English sentence summarising the key facts above.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always 'ok' when the API is running.

database.title: Database
database.description: 'connected' if the database file is present, 'missing' if not.

category.title: Category
category.description: Type of business (coffee_shop, restaurant, grocery, online_retail, electronics, streaming, fitness, or travel).

is_online.title: Is Online
is_online.description: True if this merchant operates online.

shipment.description: Shipment information for the provided transaction_id. Null if no shipment record exists or no transaction_id was given.

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: ID of the other charge that looks like a duplicate.

txn_datetime.title: Txn Datetime
txn_datetime.description: Date and time of the other charge.

minutes_apart.title: Minutes Apart
minutes_apart.description: How many minutes separated this charge from the disputed one.

ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode
ReasonCode.description: Visa reason codes DisputeDesk uses (N/A = complaint is unclear).

reason_code.title: Reason Code
reason_code.description: The reason code the dispute was assessed under.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: One of file_chargeback, deny, request_more_info or escalate. A human analyst makes the final decision.

rule_applied.title: Rule Applied
rule_applied.description: The decision rule that produced this recommendation, in plain English.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: High (4 checks passed), Medium (3) or Low (2 or fewer).

confidence_points.title: Confidence Points
confidence_points.description: How many of the 4 checks passed.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: The 4 checks behind the confidence score: within time limits, evidence found, history fits the claim, reason code clear.

key_evidence.title: Key Evidence
key_evidence.description: 2 to 4 facts, with IDs, dates and amounts, that support the recommendation.

customer_message_hint.title: Customer Message Hint
customer_message_hint.description: What the customer should be told or asked, in plain English, for the letter writer.

shipped_date.title: Shipped Date
shipped_date.description: Date the item was shipped, or null if not yet shipped.

expected_delivery_date.title: Expected Delivery Date
expected_delivery_date.description: Date the item was expected to arrive.

delivered_date.title: Delivered Date
delivered_date.description: Actual delivery date, or null if not yet delivered.

proof_of_delivery.title: Proof Of Delivery
proof_of_delivery.description: True if the carrier recorded proof of delivery (e.g. a signature or photo).

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for this transaction (e.g. TXN-000001).

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer who owns the card.

merchant_id.title: Merchant Id
merchant_id.description: The merchant that processed the charge.

txn_datetime.title: Txn Datetime
txn_datetime.description: Date and time the transaction occurred.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of the charge (always USD in this prototype).

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: How the charge was made: 'in_store', 'online', or 'recurring'.

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: Device used for online purchases. Null for in-store charges.

shipping_address_id.title: Shipping Address Id
shipping_address_id.description: Shipping address for online orders of physical goods. Null otherwise.

subscription_id.title: Subscription Id
subscription_id.description: Subscription this charge belongs to, if it is a recurring charge.

subscription_start_date.title: Subscription Start Date
subscription_start_date.description: Date the subscription started. Null if not a recurring charge.

subscription_cancelled_date.title: Subscription Cancelled Date
subscription_cancelled_date.description: Date the subscription was cancelled, or null if it is still active.

statement_date.title: Statement Date
statement_date.description: Date of the first card statement that showed this charge.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Any refunds that have been applied to this transaction.

possible_duplicates.title: Possible Duplicates
possible_duplicates.description: Other charges on the same card at the same merchant for the same amount within 24 hours. An empty list means no duplicates were found.

txn_datetime.title: Txn Datetime
txn_datetime.description: Date and time of the transaction.

shipping_address_id.title: Shipping Address Id
shipping_address_id.description: Shipping address for physical goods orders.
